skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand the nature and content of product management, from product portfolio management to product lifecycle management.
Understand the quality management model for products, including new product development and product lifecycle management.
Understand the factors influencing brand decisions and manage brand strategies.
Understand packaging management and support services for products.
Understand service management and support services for products.
Understand portfolio management and its role in business functions.
Understand the process of developing new products, including ideation, selection, testing, and commercialization.
Apply marketing strategies at different stages of the product lifecycle, from introduction to decline.
Participate in group projects involving analysis, development, and presentation of new products.
Practice teamwork, presentation, and problem-solving skills.
Develop critical thinking skills to solve problems in product management.
Develop self-management skills to take responsibility for work.
